<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sku-velocity"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The demand the planner works from: per SKU, the number of ACTIVE demand
lines (`picks`) and their units over the last `windowDays` days, ordered
by picks, then units (descending) and SKU (ascending), a page at a time
(`limit` and the opaque `cursor` of the previous `nextCursor`; filters
are repeated on every page). Read from the local demand copy (ADR 0003).
